items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Happy Schilling, yes. That's the one, yeah. Well, he's largely responsible for us playing.

ctx.x: Did they use any of these homemade instruments with those groups or did they use all regular instruments?

Well, at that particular time, they were, these boys had all batted up instruments, you know, maybe they bought, the majority of them bought them second handed. They couldn't afford to buy the new ones. They were too expensive for them. And later on, as they played, they played a lot of jobs while they got new instruments. But they were pretty high in those days. The instruments weren't so plentiful as they are today. And when we got an old batted instrument, we tried to repair it the best way we could and learn…
